item.description:
Dax 3.9.0

  • Schedules: start an agent on a task at a time or on a repeat. Type it as a sentence, like “every weekday at 9 in Dax, run the tests”, and Dax reads the time, folder and agent for you. Schedules opens as a conversation or a Month, Week, Day and Year calendar with a now-line, grouped and coloured by folder.
  • OpenCode joins Shepherd with context, resume and Dax’s tools.
  • Pair more than one iPhone or iPad with a Mac. Name or mute each device, choose which ones get notifications, send a file to just one, and ring a device to find it.
  • Agents can create and run schedules, send to one device, ring a device, and remove a picture’s background.
  • The “?” question badges and pills are gone from agent rows and panes. Real questions from dax-ask still arrive as cards.
  • The recorder’s controls fade away when the pointer leaves them, and the herd sidebar keeps its width across collapse and relaunch.
  • Fixes: the File Drawer puts its peek away when a drag lands elsewhere, Codex panes are matched more reliably, pairing retries a dropped connection, the update chime plays only when someone is at the Mac, and text on accent-coloured fills stays readable.

On Dax 3.3 or earlier? Install this release once using the Dax installer. It preserves your saved work and brings you straight to 3.9.0.
